notes: Two added units: the italic the things for, which supplies both a head noun and a function word (rule 33's limit), and the appositional even, which stands before a phrase carrying no object marker (rule 16's limit).
al is rendered by the compound preposition according to, headed on the lexeme-bearing according (rules 24, 30).
The explicit subject demonstrative takes only its own English, the copula joining the predicate (rule 20).
